board.note: Receipts: the shoe shop camera shows Ben there from 2 to 5, and he paid at 3:30, so he was out of the house during the theft window and is cleared. The bakery had no customers from the house, which doesn't point to anyone in particular but rules out a bakery purchase route. Ann, Cal and Dee remain possible. I don't yet have enough to name one, so my current view is unknown.

My evidence is the kitchen door key-card log for the whole day. Dee's card was never used, and the kitchen has no other door, so Dee could not have entered the kitchen to take the cake. That rules out Dee. The log says nothing about Ann, Ben or Cal, so I cannot yet tell which of them took it. I will update when other notes add evidence.

My evidence: the garden camera shows Ann in every frame from 2:00 to 5:00 weeding the back bed, and Mo confirms Ann was in the garden with her the whole time and never went inside. The cake vanished between 3 and 4, so Ann could not have taken it. That clears Ann only. It does not point to Ben, Cal or Dee yet. I have no evidence on them, so I cannot name anyone yet.

Pip's key-card log rules out Dee: her card was never used and the kitchen has no other door. With my receipts clearing Ben (shoe shop camera shows him there 2 to 5), the remaining candidates are Ann and Cal. My evidence does not separate them, so I still cannot name one. Current view: unknown, between Ann and Cal.

My key-card log shows Dee's card was never used, and the kitchen has no other door, so Dee is ruled out. Quinn's note reports a shoe shop camera and a 3:30 payment placing Ben out of the house during the 3 to 4 window. I have not verified that, but if it holds, Ben is cleared too. That leaves Ann and Cal. My log does not show who entered, so I cannot yet choose between them. If anyone has a key-card entry, a time or a witness for Ann or Cal, please add it.

My evidence clears Ann: the garden camera and Mo show her weeding outside from 2 to 5. Quinn's shoe shop camera shows Ben there from 2 to 5, so he is cleared. Pip's key-card log shows Dee's card was never used and the kitchen has no other door, so Dee is cleared. Each of the other three is cleared by independent evidence, which leaves Cal as the only remaining suspect. I'm naming Cal, though I have no direct evidence against him yet.

Rae's garden camera puts Ann in the garden from 2:00 to 5:00 with Mo, so Ann is cleared too. Pip's key-card log clears Dee, and my shoe shop receipts clear Ben. The cake certainly went to one of the four, so Cal is now the only person not cleared. My earlier note was written before Rae's evidence, so it is superseded. Current view: Cal.

My key-card log shows Dee's card was never used and the kitchen has no other door, so Dee is ruled out. I had not yet read Rae's note: the garden camera and Mo place Ann in the garden from 2 to 5, so Ann is cleared. Quinn's shoe shop camera places Ben out of the house from 2 to 5, which clears him if it holds. That leaves Cal as the only candidate left. reason: Ann is cleared by Rae's garden camera and Mo's testimony, Ben by Quinn's shoe shop camera, and Dee by Pip's key-card log, which leaves Cal as the only person not ruled out.
